description: This file contains functions and rules for normalizing and validating Slack configuration within the openclaw project, including legacy rule checks and configuration migration functions.

methods.name: asObjectRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if it is an object, otherwise null.

methods.name: normalizeSlackStreamingAliases
methods.description: Normalizes Slack streaming configuration aliases, updating legacy fields and recording changes.

methods.name: hasLegacySlackStreamingAliases
methods.description: Checks if a value contains legacy Slack streaming alias fields.

methods.name: hasLegacySlackAccountStreamingAliases
methods.description: Checks if any account in a collection has legacy Slack streaming alias fields.

methods.name: normalizeCompatibilityConfig
methods.description: Normalizes the Slack configuration within the provided OpenClawConfig, applying legacy rules and returning configuration mutations.
